quest.title: A Lone Ship In Guyun
quest.description: A heavily armed ship of unknown origins has stopped outside Guyun Stone Forest. You hop right on board to investigate...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x16000, Hero's Wit x2, Black-Back Perch Stew x5

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: You're... the Traveler? What are you doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just looking around...

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Looking around? You think you can waltz in here and look at whatever you please — you know what this place is?

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Hmph! Forget it, it's pointless... Oi, someone get over here! Tie up this busybody and feed 'em to the fishies!

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Alright, what's all the ruckus? You pretending to be important when Beidou's not around again?

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: This troublemaker snuck in here — presumably up to no good — and I thought I would just deal with this for Beidou...

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Alright, stop scaring people. If Beidou found out you were just tying up anyone who came in, you'd be the one being dealt with.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: B—But this troublemaker should pay for sneaking onto the ship, right?

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Our ship isn't just for people to come and go as they please.

choices.text: Yes, I must answer for my crimes.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: See!? Even the troublemaker agrees.

response.speaker: Yinxing
response.text: Hmm, I have an idea... Beidou has anchored the ship here while she goes into the city for business.

response.speaker: Yinxing
response.text: We can't leave the ship without her orders, and the rest of the fleet is on patrol at sea, so they can't help us now...

response.speaker: Yinxing
response.text: But some of the crew has errands in the city that they haven't been able to run. If you really want to make it up to us, go around the ship and see who needs help.

response.speaker: Yinxing
response.text: You seem to be quite interested in our ship anyway, so explore a bit while you're helping out.

choices.text: How should I make it up to you?

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Where could Beidou be off to...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you! So you actually did go around the ship helping people...

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Well I gotta job for you. We just pulled into shore, so we haven't had time to restock on food.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Out on the open sea for so long eating dried meat every day, it eats away at one's heart. It's not everyday we're near port, we best get some fresh food.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: But I don't know where Beidou is at, and the rest of the crew isn't to leave the ship. It'd be great if you could bring us some Fowl or Raw Meat.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: So eager... Okay, I'll leave it to you then.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: Fish? Forget it... The only fresh thing we can get when at sea is fish, fish, fish... We've had our fill.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: We want to eat something different now that we have the chance. I'll leave it to you then! Remember — Fowl or Raw Meat.

talks.objective: Give 3 portions of meat to Juza

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Hmm, we can make steak out of this, perfect to pair with a drink. Beidou will surely be pleased.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Wow, this is great! We can grill a lot of skewers of meat with this. When Beidou gets back, she'll have some nice food to chow down on with her drink.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Huh!? Looks like you forgot what I told you... If I wanted to eat Fish, I could've just caught it myself!

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Forget it, it's edible at the very least... However, Beidou will still need some meat to go with her drink when she gets back...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: When will we finally be able to get off the ship...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Eh? You're... the one who snuck onto the ship, right? I could hear Uncle Juza yelling from halfway across the ship.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Did Uncle Juza frighten you? Hehe, relax. He's a good person, he was just trying to act tough and scare you a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: But... when will we finally be able to go into the city? While Beidou is busy doing stuff in Liyue Harbor, Uncle Juza won't let us leave the ship.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Aunt Yinxing had promised to take me shopping in the city, and then I could go play with Changchang.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Last time, I told Changchang I would play with her when I got back, but now...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: You should still be able to go into the city, right? Can you help me out?

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Find some Starconches for me on the shore. I think... three will be enough.

response.speaker: Little Yue
response.text: Thank you! I really appreciate it.

choices.text: What do you want Starconches for?

response.speaker: Little Yue
response.text: I want to make a little gift so that Changchang won't get mad at me for not going to play with her...

talks.objective: Help Little Yue look for Starconches on the beach

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Did you find the Starconches?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure did.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Thank you! Wait a sec while I fiddle with these...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Aunt Yinxing taught me how to make a toy out of Starconches. Hmm, the next step is...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Little Yue isn't back yet, is he?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is a gift from Little Yue.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Little Yue is back!? Then why didn't he come over himself?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Last time he said he would come play with me, but it's been forever...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He can't leave the ship now.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Okay... He said the same thing the time before last, when a big, tall man brought me a gift from him.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Nothing he can do about it, I guess. I'm sure it's all because of Beidou again.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: But thank you anyway for the gift. Please thank Little Yue for me as well.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: When my daddy comes back, I'll ask him to take me to the ship Little Yue is on.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: If he can't come here, I can at least go to him — hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: There, all done! Can you please take this to Changchang for me?

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: I really want to give it to her myself, but... Beidou probably won't be coming back soon.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: And even when she does come back, we might just set straight out to sea again.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: *sigh* It doesn't seem like I'll be able to make it into the city this time. I hope Changchang won't get mad...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Did you give my present to Changchang?

response.speaker: Little Yue
response.text: That's good. Thanks for your help.

choices.text: She is going to come see you.

response.speaker: Little Yue
response.text: Yeah, last time she also said she was going to have her daddy bring her onto the ship.

response.speaker: Little Yue
response.text: But... Beidou and Uncle Juza won't let any strangers even get near the ship...

response.speaker: Little Yue
response.text: *sigh* Anyway, thanks again for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Did Juza frighten you? Don't take it personally, he's just like that.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: He also speaks a bit loudly on account of his poor hearing... but he's really a good person at heart.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Okay, so if you aren't busy, think you can help me with something?

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: It's been so long since we've returned to shore, but Juza is making everyone stay on the ship until Beidou gets back.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Last time I was in the city, I paid Bolai to buy some supplies in advance for when I returned.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Take this letter to Bolai, and he'll get someone to bring the supplies to the ship.

response.speaker: Yinxing
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Yinxing
response.text: Just some food, medicine, cloth, leather...

response.speaker: Yinxing
response.text: I really appreciate the help. Please get this letter to Bolai as soon as you can.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: It's been a long time. Why hasn't anyone come...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is from Yinxing.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: So now you're delivering the letter... What about the guy from last time? He's not with you, is he?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Phew, that's good... Okay, the supplies are all ready, I'll get someone to take them over in a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Guyun Stone Forest... That's a long way, I will probably need to hire a boat to get there.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Yinxing's last payment should be enough to cover it though...

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Did you deliver the letter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Thank you for your help, otherwise I would've had to ask Juza to deliver it again.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: He'd only scare Bolai, then Juza'd have to come back and drag me over anyway to explain the situation to Bolai...

dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: Who are you? How'd you get on the ship?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: What do you want? Hmph, if you're trying to rob me, think again.

dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: Get out of here fast, or you'll be sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Furong
dialogues.text: Huh... Judging by your clothes, I'd say you're the Traveler, right? What are you doing on the ship?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Furong
dialogues.text: You just came to help? Well I don't need any.

dialogues.speaker: Furong
dialogues.text: You should get out of here. You can't just come onto the ship as you please.

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: Agh! Where'd you come from!? I didn't see you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: I don't have anything you can help with. You should go back to wherever you snuck up on me from.

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: Stirring up trouble on this ship won't do you any good.

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: Who're you? You don't seem like one of the crew.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: ...I don't need your help with anything. If you aren't one of the crew, and you weren't invited, then I suggest you leave.

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: Otherwise, someone may make you leave.

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: ...Haven't seen you before. You aren't one of the crew, are you...?

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: It's been a long time since a stranger came on the ship.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: I won't ask any random stranger for help. You should leave.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: You lent a hand to so many people on the ship, I lost track.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: I'm curious, how did you get so good at helping people?

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: Hmph, "traveling around"? ...I'm sure there's more to it than that, but I won't press you.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: Take these. Consider it thanks for helping us out.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: Well, you're forgiven for sneaking onto the ship. No harm came of it anyway.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: But remember if you board the ship in the future, do it properly.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: Alright, you can go now. I have some work on the ship to take care of.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: As soon as we returned from Inazuma, Beidou had us anchor the ship here while she went into Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: But she's been gone for so long now, it's not good to just be stuck here by Guyun Stone Forest.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: I should go into the city and look for her...

choices.text: I help people solve problems for a living.

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: "Help people solve problems"? Hehe, I think I know what you mean by "problems..."

response.speaker: Juza
response.text: But I understand the rules of the trade. I won't press you.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Did you bring any meat back?

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: We should have something nice to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: I hope Changchang enjoys that toy...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: When will we finally be able to go into the city...?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Little Yue hasn't come play with me in forever — he's so annoying!

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: The money I paid him last time should be enough.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: But we still need to get new clothes for Little Yue. He's grown out of his old ones.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: When will we finally be able to go into the city...?

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: When Bolai brings the supplies over, I'll pay him for next time as well.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Just in case we can't leave the ship the next time we return to port either...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Whew, Guyun Stone Forest is a looong way from the city...

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: You're... the Traveler? What are you doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm looking for Beidou.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Looking for the Captain? Does she look like she's someone you just come "looking for" as you please?

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Oi, someone get over here! Tie this stowaway up and feed 'em to the fishies!

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, what's all the ruckus?

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: This troublemaker snuck in here. Said they're looking for... Well, they're up to no good, I'll wager — and I thought I would just deal with this for Beidou...

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Alright, stop scaring people any old how, or Captain Beidou'll scold you upside down.

dialogues.speaker: Juza
dialogues.text: Uhh... I...

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Alright. Off you go, cool your head. Now then, Traveler, what business might you have with the Captain?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to go to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: You want to go to Inazuma? By ship?

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Hmm... You'd best see the Captain herself about this. She's on board right now.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: But it seems that she's been deep in thought recently. Keep your eyes open and try not to disturb her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got it.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: *sigh* We've also been anchored here for quite a while due to her orders, which has led to quite a few delays.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: If you're willing, why don't you go around the ship and see who needs help?
